facades.name: Stadhouderskade front between the oriels
facades.note: w01-52 (2023, 42.2 px/m), the main front between the two half-round oriels (t 7.45-27.35 m from the SE end), counted per storey band from the first floor up: 18 narrow first-floor windows, then 8 office windows on each of five storeys. The oriels (curved multi-light bays, inventory f-oriels / f-oriels-l1) and the entrance bay are outside the crop; the shop floor below 4.5 m (one continuous steel-and-glass front) is excluded.
